                                ========
                                file-stx
                                ========

Thank you for downloading file-stx plug-in for GIMP!

This plug-in allows you to open and save images in the Sparkplug texture format
used in the video game Winx Club (2006).

System Requirements
-------------------

	- GIMP 3.0+
	- Windows 10 build 1903 or later (same as GIMP)

Installation
------------

	Put the contents of this archive (preserving the folder structure) at the
	following path:

		%APPDATA%\GIMP\3.0\plug-ins

	(If there is no such folder, refer to your GIMP folder settings.)

Updates and Source Code
-----------------------

	This software is free and open-source. You can acquire the program code as well
	as future releases at:

		https://github.com/kotwys/stx-gimp-plugin

	Copyright notices for third-party components are provided in NOTICES.txt.
